rules.sleepingHouseDefinition: A house is considered 'Soya Hua Ghar' (sleeping house) if no planet occupies it, or if it is not aspected by any waking planet as defined in the 1952 text.
rules.sleepingPlanetDefinition: A planet is 'Soya Hua Graha' (sleeping planet) when it does not aspect any other planet according to Lal Kitab drishti rules, or sits in a house without its natural waking trigger.

dharmiTeva.definition: A horoscope protected from severe afflictions by auspicious placements of Jupiter, Moon or benefic Saturn.
conditions: Jupiter in House 9, 10 or 11 with no malefic influence
Moon and Saturn placed together in House 1, 4, 7, 10 without mutual enmity
Rahu or Ketu in House 4 with Moon

andhaTeva.definition: A horoscope where 10th house is empty and 4th house is afflicted by opposing forces, or Saturn sits in House 7 while 1st house is unoccupied.
conditions: Saturn in 7th house and Sun in 1st house
House 10 unoccupied with opposing planets in House 4

ratondhaTeva.definition: Chart afflicted only during evening or night hours.
conditions: Sun in House 7 with Saturn in House 1

nabaligTeva.definition: Minor's chart where planetary effects remain nascent until 12 years of age.
conditions: Benefics and malefics evenly placed in kendras without aspectual triggers
